title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
summary: Everyone in the world-models space is sitting on a pile of cash and a ton of buzz, but good luck getting anyone — from the founders to their own data suppliers — to tell you what they're actually building.
reason: Media trend/commentary piece about secrecy in the world-models space; no official model announcement (R1), no primary research artifact or paper link (R2), no concrete business event such as financing, M&A, or partnership (R3), no policy action (R4), and no open-source project release (R5).
